about.title: License
about.description: Edition and license key of this installation.
about.requiredEdition: That feature is part of {edition}. Enter a license key below to unlock it.
about.getKey: A license key for Business or Service Provider is issued by the vendor; give the installation ID below when you ask for one.
about.getKeyLink: Compare editions and request a key

unlocks.business: Business unlocks, among others, the audit log, scheduled reports, journal receiving for the archive, legal holds and sign-in with Microsoft.
unlocks.service_provider: Service Provider also unlocks further tenants, the view across all tenants, the provider API and members limited to chosen tenants.

key.title: License key
key.description: Business and Service Provider are unlocked with a signed key that is bound to this installation.
key.installationIdHint: Quote this ID when you request a key.

install.title: Install a key
install.label: License key
install.hint: Paste the complete key. Line breaks added by an email client do no harm.
install.offline: Verification runs offline against the public verification key. {appName} makes no outbound connection for it.

unavailable.title: Keys cannot be verified
unavailable.unconfigured: This build carries no public verification key. Use an official release image or set RESTOW_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY.
unavailable.invalid: RESTOW_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY is set but does not contain a readable Ed25519 key. Correct the value and restart the API.
unavailable.not_configured: The installation has not been set up yet. Complete the setup wizard first.

remove.title: Remove the license key?
remove.description: Without a key, this installation runs as {edition, select, community {Community} business {Business} other {Service Provider}}. The removal is recorded in the audit log.

toasts.installed: Key installed. Edition: {edition, select, community {Community} business {Business} other {Service Provider}}.

errors.malformed: This text is not a license key. Paste the complete key exactly as it was issued.
errors.bad_signature: The signature does not match. The key was altered, or it was not issued for this installation's verification key.
errors.invalid_payload: The key is signed, but its content is incomplete or contradictory. Please contact the issuer.
errors.installation_mismatch: This key belongs to installation {keyInstallation}; this installation has the ID {installation}. Request a key for this ID.
errors.unavailable: This installation cannot verify license keys at the moment.
errors.notConfigured: The installation has not been set up yet.

blocked.title: Another tenant requires the Service Provider edition
blocked.description: The {edition, select, community {Community} business {Business} other {Service Provider}} edition manages exactly one tenant, and this installation already has it. Managing several tenants requires a Service Provider license key.

teamScope.title: Limiting members to chosen tenants requires the Service Provider edition
teamScope.description: In the {edition, select, community {Community} business {Business} other {Service Provider}} edition every member has every tenant.

reports.askProvider: The administrators of the installation (your provider) can unlock them.
